text:
tara-mktg: Quick flag from the weekly KPI review: launch-post cohort shows +55% clicks but MQL card is flat. Can analytics/ops sanity-check? :eyes:
devin-analytics: seeing same. Registrations up, MQLs unchanged. Pulling attribution joins now to check utm_campaign and routing tags.
owen-ops: We pushed inbound-parser v1.5 last night that canonicalizes campaign names. Could be aliasing launch_social_v3 -> launch_social. If dashboard expects exact name, rows could be filtered out.
devin-analytics: here's a quick query I ran: ```sql
SELECT campaign_normalized, count(*) as regs, sum(is_mql) as mqls
FROM processed_leads
WHERE event_date >= '2026-03-20' AND campaign_base = 'spring_launch'
GROUP BY 1;
```
jasper-growth: Another angle: our KPI card uses a 7d attribution window for MQLs; marketing benchmark deck uses rolling 14d. That can create apparent shortfalls when registration velocity is recent.
tara-mktg: Hmm both make sense. For the deck narrative I'd prefer: "Strong engagement from launch posts; apparent MQL shortfall likely due to recent parser normalization + shorter attribution window. Ops/Analytics investigating; numbers to be updated after backfill." Keep it punchy.
owen-ops: I'll add a temporary mapping layer to preserve legacy labels for dashboards and kick a backfill for the last 10 days. Also setting an alert if campaign-null > 1.5% for major campaigns.
devin-analytics: I'll run a backfill estimate and produce before/after delta table for the KPI slide. If mapping fixes move MQLs closer to expectation, we'll update the headline.
jasper-growth: Can we also add a small diagnostic card showing 'percent leads with campaign tag' and 'attribution window delta (7d vs 14d)' in the weekly deck? Would help PMs interpret short-term volatility.
owen-ops: Yes — wiring the monitor and adding the card to the dashboard now. ETA 2 hours for mapping + backfill job kick.
kpi-bot: KPI deck updated (auto): https://dash.redwood.ai/launch/perf-weekly — slide 3 includes temporary note about instrumentation change.
tara-mktg: Thanks team. Let's reconvene Friday AM after backfill results. If numbers don't move we'll escalate to infra for a deeper look. Coffee emoji please. :coffee:
